datasets.title: Central African Republic - Settlement Catchment Areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Central African Republic with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/central-african-republic-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded data sources (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts were disaggregated by sex and age from multiple sources, and building inventories were compiled from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets to create a baseline exposure inventory for settlements across Central African Republic.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to disaggregate population within settlement catchments

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population distribution data (2023) integrated into settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Demographic data including sex and age-disaggregated population counts (2023) for settlement areas

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprints and counts within settlement catchment areas (2024)

sources.name: Google
sources.description: High-confidence building detections (70%+ and 80%+ confidence levels) integrated into building inventory
